about_the_game:
The Soundtrack that Colors "Parry Nightmare" is Finally Here!
Enjoy the captivating tracks composed by Osamu Kubota, who brings the world of Parry Nightmare to life through music. The main theme features vocals by none other than Emi Evans, whose voice joins forces with Kubota’s composition to deliver the emotional message at the heart of Parry Nightmare.

Immerse yourself in the music that shines brilliantly within the trauma. Don’t miss it!
